title: Release branches, nothing blocks, and the transitive flow to code
reference: Trevor's product direction, 2026-11-02: running a release on a short-lived branch and merging it when the checklist is done 'sounds right'. On a released mark: 'nothing can block I think'. On which code references count: 'This should be transitive through other properties right? Stories belong to features which have implementations which link to code right? That's the point of change-saga is that transitive flow.'
